set.t: Need Knaggs Bridge location (1875 Shiawassee atlas / county history). Access: unknown. The 1902 Pioneer Collections telling predates the 1936-37 articles and names the landowner (N. G. Phillips), so the post site can be fixed from the Phillips tract on an 1870s-90s plat.

tw-mi-knaggs-bridge-gold.st: The earliest telling found (Michigan Pioneer and Historical Collections, 1902) says Whitmore Knaggs buried speculators' money around Knaggs Bridge on the Shiawassee. A man named Hadd dug for it about twenty years later, and before the Civil War parties dug at night by a map that marked 'the rock, the tree, and the spring' (E. O. Byam showed them the spring). It names storekeeper Thomas B. Allen, and says the post site then belonged to Hon. N. G. Phillips.
src: Michigan Pioneer and Historical Collections, vol. 32 (1902), pp. 261-263, 'Knaggs' Buried Gold'
